# Bind address<AvailableFrom v="4.0.537" />

The address that the HTTP server which serves the bundle and the OffthreadVideo frames during a render listens on, for example `127.0.0.1` or `::1`. By default, the server listens on all network interfaces (`::`, or `0.0.0.0` if IPv6 is not available), which makes it reachable from other machines on the network for the duration of the render.<br />The browser always connects to the server via `localhost`, so the address you pass must resolve to the same host that runs the render.

## CLI flag

```text
--bind-address <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)
- [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`getCompositions()`](/docs/renderer/get-compositions#bindaddress)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#bindaddress)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#bindaddress)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#bindaddress)
- [`selectComposition()`](/docs/renderer/select-composition#bindaddress)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setBindAddress('127.0.0.1');
```
